strings.subtitle: — Uwangiza dosiye —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Gukurura no kureka ntibiboneka. Koresha buto yo hepfo.
strings.shred_button: A N G I Z A
strings.ssd_warning:
Iburira! Kuri SSD uburyo bwo kwandika hejuru ntibwemeza kurangiza kubera TRIM.
Iyi porogaramu ni iya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Dosiye "{name}" izandikwa hejuru kandi isibwe.

Komeza?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
This is a shortcut (.lnk). Only the shortcut itself will be destroyed.

The target file it points to will remain intact.

Continue?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
This is a network drive (\\server\share).
Sector overwrite does not guarantee destruction — the server may have snapshots, deduplication or CoW.

Continue?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
This is a removable drive (USB stick / external HDD).
The controller may keep old blocks in reserve.

Continue?
strings.report_limits:
• Imigezi y'amakuru y'ubundi buryo ya NTFS (ADS) ntisubirwamo.
• Ikinyamakuru USN nticyisukurwa.
• Kopi z'igicucu n'ihuza ry'ibicu
  (OneDrive n'ibindi) ntibigira ingaruka.
strings.status_full: Ibiri muri dosiye byanditswe hejuru rwose ku busa. Gusubiza ntibishoboka — ibikoresho bizabona gusa ubusa.
strings.status_fast: Umutwe, umurizo n'imirongo 4 MB byanditswe hejuru. Ibisigaye ntibyakozweho, ariko kubera umwanya, gusubiza byuzuye n'ibikoresho by'abakoresha ntibishoboka. Ku nyandiko z'ibanga koresha uburyo BWUZUYE.
strings.status_empty: Dosiye yari ubusa, kwandika hejuru ntibyari ngombwa. Yasibwe.
strings.error_permission: Ntishoboka kugera kuri dosiye. Ishobora kuba ifunguye muri porogaramu indi. Funga hanyuma ugerageze.
strings.error_is_symlink: Iyi ni umurongo w'ikimenyetso. Imirongo ntishobora kwangizwa — dosiye ntego izaguma yuzuye.
strings.error_reparse: Iyi ni dosiye y'ahantu (OneDrive cyangwa nkayo). Amakuru yayo ari mu bicu, atari kuri disiki — nta kintu cyo kwangiza hano.
strings.error_not_file: Iyi ntabwo ari dosiye (ububiko cyangwa ikindi). Reka dosiye.
strings.error_hardlinks: Iyi dosiye ifite izindi nzira zikomeye ({n} byose). Inzira zikomeye nta nkuru ifite — amazina yose angana. Niba wangiza unyuze mu nzira ya none, amakuru azandikwa hejuru kandi acishwe kuri bayiti 32, ariko ibisigaye bizaguma bigerwaho binyuze mu zindi nzira. Banza usibe inzira zose.
strings.error_compressed:
Dosiye yakozwe, yashyizwemo ibanga cyangwa ni yoroheje. Kwandika hejuru ku busa ntibyemeza kwangiza amakuru ya kera kubera NTFS ibika mu bundi buryo.

Kuraho ikiranga: kanda iburyo → Ibiranga → By'umwihariko → kuraho akamenyetso ka "Kugabanya" na/cg "Gushyira ibanga". Hanyuma ukoresha SHREDDER ukundi.
